We need DBE for formula C11H13O4N. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring O, S, halogens). So compute: C=11, H=13, N=1.

DBE = 11 - 13/2 + 1/2 + 1 = 11 - 6.5 + 0.5 +1 = 6.0. So integer 6.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. Might still call retrieve_dbe_formula to be safe. Use tool.
